purpose: Teach: Ｗ杯/ワタ/笋/鬚/鵑/颪/蕕/紊

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、Ｗ杯協賛の事業企画を進めろ
lines.en: Drive forward the business plan for our World Cup sponsorship.
lines.style: Clipped command. No warmth. Expectation of immediate execution. Eyes forward, jaw set slightly. The voice of someone used to being obeyed without explanation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。繊維事業、つまりワタの原料調達を強化します
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen raw cotton sourcing for our textile division.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Direct, no embellishment. Keeping pace with the boss's tempo. Slight nod forward — showing he's already thinking operationally about this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、食品事業で笋、つまりタケノコの加工品を増やせ
lines.en: Expand our processed bamboo shoot products in the food division.
lines.style: Same clipped authority. Slightly faster delivery, like he's moving through a list. No pause for questions. The tone of someone with many things to move through this morning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。化粧品事業で「鬚、つまり髭ケア」商品を展開します
lines.en: Understood. We'll roll out beard care products in our cosmetics line.
lines.style: Quick confirmation. Energy intact but showing he's absorbing multiple directives. Slight professional distance — taking notes internally, staying aligned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、観光事業で「杜鵑、つまり鵑の名所」を売り出せ
lines.en: Promote famous cuckoo bird spots through our tourism division.
lines.style: Another command, same authority. Voice slightly more measured here — this one takes a beat longer to land. Not quite skeptical, but testing if he's still tracking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。気象、つまり颪のデータを物流計画に反映します
lines.en: Yes. I'll incorporate mountain wind data into our logistics planning.
lines.style: Keeps responding without missing a beat. The tiredness is starting to show in the smallest way — barely perceptible slowing. Still professional, but the list is getting absurd and both know it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、漢方事業で蕕、つまり生薬の供給を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our herbal medicine supply in the traditional medicine division.
lines.style: The final command. Slightly lower pitch — authority settling in. He's not speeding up or slowing down. Just moving through it. Clinical, almost.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の紊乱、つまり紊れた状況に備えます
lines.en: Yes. We'll prepare for market disruption and instability.
lines.style: The finale. Quieter than before. Still respectful, but there's something underneath — a tiny crack of acknowledgment that this list has been absurd. He lands on 'disruption' with a small, ironic weight. Preparing for chaos while executing orders for bamboo shoots.
